subject: #25 suite drift s316g→s316r: run/-family "Perl lib version mismatch" crash + re/-family List::Util loadable-object crash
description:
Two crash clusters found by the s316r full suite re-run (48 OK/31 NOTAP/97 XDIFF/257 UNEXPLAINED, snapshot docs/perl-suite-run.tsv at gen v2-85). Both already present in a v2-84 run (pre-#134), so they drifted during s316h–s316q.

Cluster 1 — run/runenv.t, runenv_randseed.t, runenv_hashseed.t, switches.t, switchM.t, switcht.t, switchDx.t, locale.t (0/0), plus comp/require.t 34→31 and run/exit.t 14→13, run/switchF2.t 5→4: crash sig `simple-error: sbcl: Perl lib version (N.N.N) doesn't match executable '/home/bernt/perlN/perlbrew/perls/...'` — a child perl invocation dies in lib.pm version check. Prime suspect: s316m's run-perl-suite.pl updir mirror (symlinks perl's SOURCE root, including lib/, next to the shadow t/), so children spawned with relative PERL5LIB now resolve ../lib to perl-5.40.3's build lib and version-mismatch. Likely a HARNESS fixture bug, not a compiler bug — but runenv.t previously ran 11/95 and now produces nothing.

Cluster 2 — re/regexp.t, regexp_qr.t, regexp_qr_embed.t, regexp_noamp.t, regexp_notrie.t, regexp_trielist.t (all truncate at ~case 38), re/regexp_normal.t (1850→965), re/alpha_assertions.t (1784→468), re/regex_sets_compat.t (1600→98): crash sig `Can't locate loadable object for module List::Util in @INC at (eval N) line N`. Something in these files' harness path now triggers a real XSLoader::load('List::Util') that the XS artifact cache can't satisfy (Scalar-List-Utils not installed for the current pclxs ABI, or the shim's XSLoader hook mis-fires under string-eval). Check whether lib/List/Util.pm's pure-perl shim should have short-circuited the XS load.

Repro rows in the s316r ledger; per-file counts in docs/perl-suite-run.tsv vs git show HEAD~1:docs/perl-suite-run.tsv.
